title: Hazel and the Deadline
author: Bram Sterling
blurb: Mara Fairweather, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
